title: Geometry in Groups II
about: The International Centre for Theoretical Sciences (ICTS-TIFR) in Bengaluru, India, hosts the programme Geometry in Groups II from 28 June to 9 July 2027, organised by Radhika Gupta, Suraj Krishna M S and Bratati Som. The application deadline is 15 January 2027.
card_alt: Card for Geometry in Groups II at the International Centre for Theoretical Sciences (ICTS-TIFR), Bengaluru, India; deadline 15 Jan 2027. The photo shows the Taj Mahal in Agra, not Bengaluru.
